title: Probabilistic sensitivity analysis, CEAC, and EVPI
primary_chapter_title: Decision Modelling, Simulation, and the Value of Information
purpose: Propagates uncertainty in incremental costs and effects through Monte Carlo simulation, estimates cost-effectiveness probabilities across thresholds, and computes expected value of perfect information.
input: `Parameters` sheet with means, standard deviations, correlation, number of simulations, and threshold range.
outputs: Simulation draws, cost-effectiveness plane, CEAC, EVPI by threshold, probability of cost-effectiveness, and reproducible seed metadata.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
